messages:
jen_support: Hi @mike_infra — onboarding for AcmeCorp private VPC. Installer fails to pull model shards and runtime telemetry POSTs are 502/SSL errors. Security wants a minimal outbound allowlist we can hand them. I pasted a couple of repro snippets below.

mike_infra: can you drop the exact curl/openssl output and one installer log snippet? also which region (aws/gcp/azure)?

jen_support: region: us-west-2 (customer-managed VPC). Installer command we run: 
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' https://shards.prod.redwood.ai/models/abc123/shard_0 --output /dev/null
```
output: 
```
* About to connect() to shards.prod.redwood.ai port 443 (#0)
* Connected to shards.prod.redwood.ai (10.0.0.1) port 443 (#0)
* ALPN, offering http/1.1
* TLSv1.2 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.2 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2)
* TLSv1.2 (IN), TLS handshake, Certificate (11)
* SSL: certificate subject: CN=corp-proxy.local
* SSL: certificate issuer: CN=Internal Proxy CA
* SSL: certificate verify result: unable to get local issuer certificate (20), continuing.
* SSL: TLSv1.2 (IN), TLS handshake, Finished (20)
* SSL: TLSv1.2 (OUT), TLS alert, unknown CA (560)
* Closing connection 0
curl: (56) SSL read: error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure
```

jen_support: installer log shows TLS handshake failure when contacting telemetry too: 
```
POST https://telemetry.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -> SSLHandshakeException: Received fatal alert: handshake_failure
```

sophia_eng: looks like corporate TLS interception is replacing certs (CN=corp-proxy.local). For model shards and telemetry we do certificate pinning/OCSP checks so SNI passthrough is required. Minimal hosts to request from security team: list below (443 only). Also include OCSP endpoints.

sophia_eng: Minimal allowlist we recommend (hostnames only):
• shards.prod.redwood.ai
• models.redwood.ai (model registry API)
• telemetry.redwood.ai (telemetry ingestion)
• auth.redwood.ai (OAuth/token exchange)
• packages.redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com (model artifacts)
• files.pythonhosted.org (pip wheels)
• pypi.org (package metadata)
• registry.npmjs.org (npm)
• kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com (if using KMS for keys)

sophia_eng: OCSP/responder + CA endpoints to allow passthrough (common cases):
• ocsp.digicert.com
• ocsp.int-x3.letsencrypt.org (or your CA's OCSP host)
• crl distribution points for customer CAs if they validate those — ask security.

sophia_eng: Also: port 443 only, and ensure the proxy does NOT terminate TLS for these hostnames (i.e., allow SNI passthrough). If they need IPs, warn them that CDN-backed hosts resolve to many IPs and are dynamic — prefer FQDNs.

eli_devex: quick repro commands to give security so they can test connectivity themselves: 
```
# verify TLS chain and SNI passthrough
openssl s_client -connect shards.prod.redwood.ai:443 -servername shards.prod.redwood.ai -brief
# test model registry API (no token needed to check TLS)
curl -v https://models.redwood.ai/healthz
# test telemetry endpoint reachability
curl -v -X OPTIONS https://telemetry.redwood.ai/v1/ingest
```

mike_infra: if they absolutely can't allow SNI passthrough, the immediate installer workaround is to set telemetry off for install and pre-pull model shards via a controlled jumpbox that has egress. Not ideal for long-term. Example env override: `REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_DISABLE=1 ./installer.sh` — only for provisioning.

jen_support: perfect — can you generate one email-friendly block (short, copy-paste) for security with the minimal hosts + reasoning? I want to send to AcmeCorp Security.

sophia_eng: sure — copy-paste below.

jen_support: (pasting)
"Hello Security team — to complete our private installer and runtime for AcmeCorp we require outbound HTTPS (port 443) to the following FQDNs with SNI passthrough (no TLS intercept/termination). These hosts are used for model shard downloads, model registry API, telemetry, auth, and package pulls. Blocking or intercepting TLS for these endpoints will cause installer failures and runtime errors due to certificate pinning and OCSP validation. Minimal FQDNs: shards.prod.redwood.ai, models.redwood.ai, telemetry.redwood.ai, auth.redwood.ai, packages.redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com, files.pythonhosted.org, pypi.org, registry.npmjs.org. Also allow OCSP responders (e.g., ocsp.digicert.com) used by CA. Ports: 443 only. If IP allowlisting is required, please coordinate — these FQDNs are CDN-backed and IPs vary. If you need an exception window, we can do a timeboxed installation using a bastion with egress.

jen_support: sending now. thanks all :thumbsup:

mike_infra: thx — once security confirms, ask them to test the three openssl/curl commands above and paste outputs here. We'll verify cert CNs show the real Redwood CNs (not corp-proxy).

eli_devex: note for records — ticket #INC-2034 opened for AcmeCorp onboarding. Keep thread updated with security responses.

jen_support: closing loop for now. will repost if they push back. :wave:"
